latest_release.name: v0.12.1
latest_release.body:
# v0.12.1

**大肥鱼 was somebody else's mascot. The slot now uses our own.**

The whale girl was drawn after another company's logo — their mascot turned into a person. She is replaced
by **Andee娘**: the plush ball from the brand illustrations as a cat-eared girl. Its periwinkle felt and
peach rim glow, its two tiny horns in front of fluffy cat ears, paw-pad mittens, a cat tail, and the core
worn like a bell.

> **These binaries carry no credentials.** No CodeFlying key, no voice-provider key, and no Google key.
> **You supply your own**: sign up from the link inside the app, then paste the key into
> **Settings → Backend**. Starting is free and the free allowance is finite.
>
> Each package already points at the right server for its language — the English ones at
> `myapp.codeflying.app`, the Chinese at `baas.kuafuai.net`. You do not choose this.
>
> **The macOS packages are signed with a local identity, not an Apple Developer ID**, so Gatekeeper
> refuses the first launch. On macOS 15 the old "right-click → Open" trick no longer exists; see
> **[Opening the Mac app](#opening-the-mac-app)**.

## Highlights

- **Andee娘 replaces 大肥鱼.** The same slot, but the idea now lands on our own character instead of
  someone else's: the brand's plush ball as a cat-eared girl — periwinkle felt, peach rim glow, tiny horns
  in front of cat ears, paw-pad mittens, a cat tail, the core worn like a bell.
- **If you had picked her, nothing happens.** The saved id reads as the new one — you keep the look, the
  voice and the manner.
- **She keeps the same voice and the same temper** (sweet, soft, a little shy, earnest about the work).

## What's Changed

### Changed

- **Andee娘 replaces 大肥鱼 as a pet look.** Fins, whale tail and maid dress are gone, along with every
  fish drawing on both bodies — **72 files out, 72 in** (a full set per pose, per body).
  - **Nobody's saved choice is lost.** The new id is `andee-girl`, and a saved `fish` — plus the `lady` /
    `blue-girl` ids that already pointed at it — reads as her through `PetCharacters.canonical`. The Mac's
    look shelf now canonicalises the saved value **before** highlighting it; before this, a renamed id
    highlighted nothing at all, which is the part that would have looked like a bug.
  - **Same voice, same manner.** The fish-and-snacks lines are gone; in their place are rare cat touches,
    kept **rarer than the kitten look's** so the two do not read as each other.

### Fixed

- **Every pose edit was coming back as the reference image on a painted room.**
  `tools/pet_sprites.py` had a semicolon inside one pose prompt, and `curl -F` reads a `;` in a field value
  as the start of a **field attribute** — it then drops the rest of that value **silently**. So the prompt,
  including the request for a transparent background, was being cut in half without any error. The prompt
  now goes out through `--form-string`, which takes its value literally. (The non-text fields still use
  `-F`, which is correct for things like `image=@file;type=image/png`.)

### Documentation

- **The three previous releases' notes each named a `versionCode` one lower than it was**, and all three
  published Release pages have been corrected. The tags were never wrong — their annotation bodies were
  written from the real change each time — and **no package needed rebuilding**: the number inside the APK
  was always right, only the sentence describing it was not. The cause was that the notes' Download section
  is copied forward from the previous release, and v0.10.0's versionCode line was bumped from the previous
  file instead of read from `app/build.gradle`; every release after it then bumped the same wrong number.

## Known issues

- **The new drawings have not been seen on a real device.** Andee娘's twenty poses are edits of one idle
  drawing, checked against the brand illustrations — but the same caveat as v0.12.0's pet applies and is

Andee

It becomes the soul of the device.

Not the assistant that helps you operate your phone — not a tool, not a companion. What moves in is not an app on the phone. A phone, a Mac, a tablet — each is a body it lives in. And the Andees on different devices can be **friends**. No root. No custom ROM. One APK on Android, one app on the Mac.
